auth.description: Contentful Content Delivery API (CDA) access token, sent as a bearer. Read-only: published content in one space only, and only the Delivery API accepts it
auth.name: contentful.delivery_token
auth.subject: unstated

auth.description: Contentful Content Management API (CMA) access token, sent as a bearer. Read and write in one space; the Delivery API rejects it. Required only for contentful-entry-create and contentful-entry-publish — every read above uses the Delivery token instead
auth.name: contentful.management_token
auth.subject: unstated

config.help: Found on the space's Settings > General settings page in the Contentful web app. Identifies which space the delivery token reads from
config.label: Contentful space ID
config.name: delivery_space_id

config.help: The environment within the space to read from — commonly `master` unless this space uses staged environments
config.label: Contentful environment
config.name: delivery_environment_id

config.help: Create a Content Delivery API access token in the space under Settings > API keys. Read-only: published content in this space only
config.label: Contentful Delivery API token
config.name: delivery_token

config.help: Found on the space's Settings > General settings page in the Contentful web app. Identifies which space the management token writes to
config.label: Contentful space ID
config.name: management_space_id

config.help: The environment within the space to write to — commonly `master` unless this space uses staged environments
config.label: Contentful environment
config.name: management_environment_id

config.help: Create a Content Management API token (a Personal Access Token) in the space under Settings > API keys > Content management tokens. Grants create and publish access in this space — never reuse the Delivery token here
config.label: Contentful Management API token
config.name: management_token

description: Contentful headless CMS: read published content from the Content Delivery API, and create and publish entries through the Content Management API — two different hosts and two different tokens for one vendor

operations.description: Get one published entry by id, with its fields resolved to one locale

params.description: The entry's id, from contentful-entries-list or the Contentful web app
params.name: entry_id

fields.description: The entry's own field values, keyed by this space's content-model field ids — chosen by whoever built the content type, and not knowable at build time. See contentful-entry-create's header comment for why this is described rather than enumerated

sys.description: Envelope metadata: at least `id`, `type` ("Entry"), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`, `revision`, and links to this entry's content type, space and environment

operations.description: List published entries in this space and environment, most recently updated first. This connector's `verify` — a bounded read that runs unattended: space and environment are already resolved from configuration, and `limit`/`skip` are optional, so no required argument is ever needed

params.description: Maximum entries to return. Contentful defaults to 100 and caps at 1000
params.name: limit

params.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging
params.name: skip

items.description: One entry per result, each shaped like contentful-entry-get's response

sys.description: The envelope's own type marker, e.g. `{"type": "Array"}`

total.description: Total matching entries in the space, not just this page

operations.description: Get one published asset (an uploaded file, e.g. an image) by id, with its metadata resolved to one locale

params.description: The asset's id, from an entry's own field links or the Contentful web app
params.name: asset_id

fields.description: At least `title` and `file`; `file` carries `url` (schemeless, prefix with `https:`), `fileName`, `contentType`, and a vendor `details` object (`size`, plus `image: {width, height}` for image assets). `description` is present when the asset has one

operations.description: Create a new entry from a content type's field values. Contentful assigns the entry's id. The entry is created as a draft — it is not visible through the Delivery API until contentful-entry-publish publishes it

params.description: The id of the content type this entry is an instance of. Required by Contentful on every create; there is no default
params.name: content_type_id

schema.description: The entry's field values: `{"fields": {<field id>: {<locale>: <value>}}}`. Both the field ids and the locale keys (e.g. `en-US`) are this space's own content model and are not knowable at build time — see the header comment for why this is one opaque schema rather than named fields

fields.description: Echoes the field values just written

sys.description: At least `id` (the new entry's id, for contentful-entry-publish), `type` ("Entry"), `version` (the optimistic-concurrency stamp contentful-entry-publish's `X-Contentful-Version` header needs), `createdAt`, `updatedAt`

operations.description: Publish a draft entry, making it visible through the Delivery API. Sends no body

params.description: The entry's id, from contentful-entry-create or a prior read
params.name: entry_id

params.description: The entry's current `sys.version` (from contentful-entry-create or a subsequent read). Contentful rejects the request with a version conflict if this is stale, which is the optimistic-concurrency check that keeps a publish from clobbering someone else's more recent edit
params.name: version

services.description: Content Delivery API (CDA): read-only access to this space's published content. Authenticates with the delivery token; the management token cannot reach this surface
services.name: delivery

services.description: Content Management API (CMA): create and publish entries. Authenticates with the management token; the delivery token cannot reach this surface
services.name: management
